description_expanded: SummaryDiscover the beauty of the Emerald Coast at our vacation rental. This expansive home offers a seamless open layout, featuring a large Smart TV in the great room and a secondary entertainment hub on the top floor. The exterior boasts a private patio with a gas grill, a spacious backyard for outdoor relaxation, and a shared pool. Whether you are lounging on the private balcony or exploring nearby Seaside, our property serves as a bright and airy sanctuary for families and groups.SpaceLocation perks: Deer Lake State Park (1.8 miles), Seagrove Beach (2.2 miles), Seaside (3.1 miles), Watersound (5.5 miles), Rosemary Beach (5.7 miles). Interior: — Kitchen (drip coffee maker, Keurig, Crockpot, air fryer, blender, toaster, cooking utensils, tableware) — 6 Smart TVs (55” in great room) — Gas grill — In-unit washer and dryer — Free WiFi — Central heat and central air conditioning — 2,144 sq. ft. Exterior: — Gas grill — Backyard — Balcony — Patio — Shared Community Pool — On-site parking for 4 cars in the driveway Lower floor: 3 bedrooms (1 queen bed, 4 twin bunk beds, 1 king bed), 2 full bathrooms (1 en-suite) Main floor: Kitchen, dining area, living room, 1 bedroom (2 queen beds), 1 full bathroom Upper floor: Bonus living room (1 queen pull-out sofa), balcony NeighborhoodLocated in the charming community, our property offers a peaceful coastal vibe just a short distance from the sugar-white sands of the Gulf. The area is known for its laid-back atmosphere, scenic coastal dune lakes, and lush state parks perfect for hiking and biking. You are ideally situated to explore the unique shops and famous dining options in nearby Seaside and along the Scenic Highway 30A corridor. From casual beachside cafes to upscale seafood restaurants, the neighborhood provides a diverse array of activities and entertainment for all ages throughout the year. TransitA car is recommended for navigating the 30A area, and our property provides a wide driveway with space for 4 vehicles. Many guests also enjoy renting bicycles to utilize the local bike paths that connect the nearby coastal communities. AccessGuests have private access to the entire three-story home, including the backyard, patio, and top-floor balcony. The laundry facilities, gas grill, and driveway parking are all private for guest use.NotesPlease be aware of the beach flags before entering the ocean. Shared pool maintenance is outside of our control and can be unpredictable.House Rules1. Smoking is NOT allowed inside the Rental Property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged to guests if smoking inside Rental Property occurs or evidence is found of smoking inside. 2. People other than included in the Guest Count may not stay in the property. Any other person on Rental Property is the sole responsibility of Guest. 3. Quiet Hours are 10pm – 8am. Excessive noise inside these hours are not permitted and will result in eviction and cancellation with no refund. 4. Rental Property is privately owned; Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the Rental Property or its facilities. The Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the Guest and Rental Party. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that Guests and Rental Party are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the Rental Property or others whom they invite to use the Rental Property. 5. Guest agrees to keep the property and all furnishings in good order and only use appliances for their intended uses. 6. Pets are not allowed. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged and Guest will be evicted. 7. Housekeeping: There is no daily housekeeping service. While linens and bath towels are included in the unit, daily maid service is not included in the rental rate. We do not permit towels or linens to be taken from the property unless used for amenities outside the property such as shared hot tub and pool areas. Please return the linens in the Property after use. 8. Water and Septic: The septic system is very effective; however, it will clog up if improper material is flushed. DO NOT FLUSH anything other than toilet paper. No feminine products should be flushed at any time. If it is found that feminine products have been flushed and clog the septic system, you will be charged for any damages incurred by Property Manager or Owner. 9. Renter(s) are responsible for themselves, their family and guests at all times. Children should be supervised at all times. 10. If Rental Party exceeds the maximum occupancy Guest will be asked to leave the Rental Property with no refunds. Infants under 2 years are not counted. 11. At least one parent or adult must be present at all times when children under the age of 16 are in the Rental Property or using any of outdoor facilities such as Hot Tub. 12. Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for money, jewelry, or other valuables lost, stolen, or left behind in the Rental Property, but will use their best effort to remedy the situation. 13. No rowdy behavior is permitted. Guests must behave at all times, in a reasonable and proper manner and act in a way as to protect the Rental Property, its contents and furnishings against damage. Failure to do so could result in eviction. 14. No subletting of the Rental Property or assigning of this agreement is permitted. 15. Please note that we charge per guest after a set number. Please provide the entire group count in your reservation request. If an update to the group count is needed after confirming the reservation, the reservation cost may increase. 16. Guest must obtain approval prior to checking in early or check out late. If Guest enter the Rental Property before agreed upon Check In Time or leave the Rental Property after agreed upon Check Out Time, Guest will be charged $50/half hour. 17. Guest is responsible to learn and understand any mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19 before confirming a reservation. 18. Guest agrees to follow all local, state and federal level mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19. Violations that result in fines based on Guests' actions will be passed on to the Guest. 19. Guest agrees that they are 25 years of age or older. 20. If applicable, Guest may be responsible for loss of any parking passes/permits in amounts up to $400 per pass/permit. 21. Emotional Support Animals (ESA) are not allowed unless explicitly approved by Owner/Manager. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged to the Guest and Guest will be evicted. Read Less
